# Architecture Blueprint: Bright Path Wellness - HubSpot Rebuild

_Generated at <TIMESTAMP>_

## Warnings
- Multiple currencies in scope (USD, CAD); defaulted base currency to 'USD' — confirm with finance/ops before build.
- Custom object notes provided but not auto-modeled — review manually: "Also considering a 'Class Session' object in a later phase; out of scope for this build."

## Custom Objects
| Name | Plural Label | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Membership | Memberships | Tracks an individual membership term, tied to a Contact. |
| Subscription | Subscriptions | Tracks a recurring subscription/billing term, tied to a Contact and optionally a Deal. |
| Location | Locations | Tracks a physical or service location, tied to a Company. |

## Data Dictionary
| Object | Property | Label | Type | Required | Options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contact | lifecyclestage | Lifecycle Stage | enumeration | True |  | Standard HubSpot lifecycle stage; required for reporting handoffs between hubs. |
| Contact | hs_lead_status | Lead Status | enumeration | False |  | Tracks sales follow-up status independent of lifecycle stage. |
| Contact | mystudio_member_id | MyStudio Member ID | string | False |  | External ID linking this contact to their MyStudio member record. |
| Contact | sms_opt_in | SMS Opt-In | bool | False |  | Whether the contact has opted in to SMS via Sakari. |
| Contact | sakari_last_message_at | Sakari Last Message At | datetime | False |  | Timestamp of the most recent Sakari SMS interaction. |
| Company | industry | Industry | enumeration | False |  | Standard HubSpot industry classification. |
| Deal | dealstage | Deal Stage | enumeration | True |  | Current stage within the deal pipeline. |
| Deal | amount | Amount | number | True |  | Deal value in the base currency unless overridden. |
| Deal | payment_status | Payment Status | enumeration | False | Not Started, Pending, Paid, Failed, Refunded | Status of the associated payment from the payments provider. |
| Deal | payment_provider_id | Payment Provider Transaction ID | string | False |  | External transaction/reference ID from the payments provider. |
| Ticket | hs_pipeline_stage | Pipeline Stage | enumeration | True |  | Current stage within the ticket pipeline. |
| Membership | membership_status | Membership Status | enumeration | True | Active, Paused, Cancelled, Expired | Current status of the membership term. |
| Membership | start_date | Start Date | date | True |  | Membership term start date. |
| Membership | end_date | End Date | date | False |  | Membership term end date, if fixed-term. |
| Subscription | subscription_status | Subscription Status | enumeration | True | Active, Paused, Cancelled, Past Due | Current status of the subscription. |
| Subscription | billing_frequency | Billing Frequency | enumeration | True | Monthly, Quarterly, Annual | How often the subscription bills. |
| Location | location_status | Location Status | enumeration | True | Active, Inactive | Whether the location is currently operating. |
| Location | region | Region | string | False |  | Free-text region/territory label for the location. |

## Association Model
| From | To | Label | Cardinality |
|---|---|---|---|
| Membership | Contact | Membership to Contact | many-to-one |
| Subscription | Contact | Subscription to Contact | many-to-one |
| Subscription | Deal | Subscription to Deal | one-to-one |
| Location | Company | Location to Company | many-to-one |

## Pipelines & Stages
### Deal Pipeline (Deal)
| Order | Stage | Closed | Won |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Appointment Scheduled | False | False |
| 1 | Qualified To Buy | False | False |
| 2 | Presentation Scheduled | False | False |
| 3 | Decision Maker Bought In | False | False |
| 4 | Contract Sent | False | False |
| 5 | Closed Won | True | True |
| 6 | Closed Lost | True | False |

### Ticket Pipeline (Ticket)
| Order | Stage | Closed | Won |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | New | False | False |
| 1 | Waiting on Contact | False | False |
| 2 | Waiting on Us | False | False |
| 3 | Closed | True | True |

### Membership Pipeline (Membership)
| Order | Stage | Closed | Won |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | New | False | False |
| 1 | In Progress | False | False |
| 2 | Completed | True | True |
| 3 | Cancelled | True | False |

## Naming Conventions
- **custom_object_name**: Singular PascalCase, e.g. 'Membership' not 'Memberships' or 'membership'.
- **property_internal_name**: snake_case, e.g. 'membership_status'.
- **workflow_name_pattern**: '<Object> | <Purpose>', e.g. 'Contact | Sync MyStudio Membership Status'.
- **pipeline_name_pattern**: '<Object> Pipeline', e.g. 'Deal Pipeline'.

## Base Currency
Base currency: USD. When more than one currency is in scope, always define exactly one base currency for roll-up reporting; deal/line-item currency fields should default to it.

## Suggested Workflows
| Name | Object | Trigger | Action | Overwrite Risk | Risk Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contact | Sync MyStudio Membership Status | Contact | MyStudio member status changes (via integration) | Update mystudio_member_status and mystudio_last_synced_at from the MyStudio integration payload. | **YES** | Sets/updates a property unconditionally — add an 'only if blank' or conditional branch. |
| Contact | Log Sakari SMS Reply | Contact | Inbound SMS reply received in Sakari | Log a timeline event and update sakari_last_message_at. | **YES** | Sets/updates a property unconditionally — add an 'only if blank' or conditional branch. |
| Deal | Sync Payment Status | Deal | Payment status changes in the payments provider | Set payment_status and payment_provider_id from the incoming payment webhook. | **YES** | Sets/updates a property unconditionally — add an 'only if blank' or conditional branch. |
| Membership | Notify Owner on Status Change | Membership | Membership status property changes | Notify record owner when membership_status changes | No |  |
| Subscription | Notify Owner on Status Change | Subscription | Subscription status property changes | Notify record owner when subscription_status changes | No |  |
| Location | Notify Owner on Status Change | Location | Location status property changes | Notify record owner when location_status changes | No |  |
| Contact | Set Lifecycle Stage to Customer | Contact | Associated Deal enters Closed Won stage | Set lifecyclestage to Customer | **YES** | Sets/updates a property unconditionally — add an 'only if blank' or conditional branch. |
| Contact | Set Lead Source (Only If Blank) | Contact | Contact created | Set lead source only if blank | No |  |
